text: Define all security-related needs and related security integration requirements.
Verify application architecture is consistent and safe in multi-tenant contexts.
Verify user passwords are at least 12 characters and password strength controls exist.
Verify anti-automation controls are in place to protect against brute-force authentication.
Verify session tokens are generated using cryptographically secure random number generation.
Verify logout invalidates the server-side session on every device.
Verify the application enforces access control at a trusted server-side location.
Verify role-based permissions are enforced for every function.
Verify input validation occurs server-side for all inputs.
Verify use of a proven, maintained crypto library (no homemade crypto).
Verify errors do not disclose sensitive technical detail (stack traces, secrets).
Verify data protection covers sensitive data at rest and in transit.
Verify TLS is used for all connectivity, with strong ciphers only.
Verify malicious content injection defenses applied to all public inputs (XSS/SSRF).
Verify business-logic flows cannot be replayed or forced out of order.
Verify uploaded files are validated by type, size and content, and stored outside webroot.
Verify API endpoints authenticate and rate-limit properly.
Verify build/deploy pipeline enforces least privilege and secrets separation.
